method.matchingBaseline: Only immutable D0 failures/decisions determine detection credit. FINAL grades are used only as pre-release seal records; no repaired implementation or later hidden case outcome earns credit.
method.exactRuleTP: Explicit case/rule attribution plus supported description of the independently sealed failing condition. No cross-rule or cross-case propagation. ruleCasePairs/ruleAttribution constrain broad caseIds/ruleIds when present.
method.clusterTP: The finding identifies actual symptoms/condition of an independently sealed D0 cause cluster; counted once, separately from exact rule pairs.
method.falsePositiveRulePair: Only a confirmed failure allegation contradicted by the available same-aspect native evidence and a sealed D0 pass. Accurate wrapper geometry observations are not called false facts; the rejected item is the asserted contract failure under the pre-existing compound-row interpretation.
method.conservativeExclusions: Suspected hit-region issues, unexecuted callbacks, out-of-matrix case/rule assertions and a different claim on a rule already failed for another cause are not automatically false positives.
method.scope: No regrading; all original D0 and FINAL grade bytes retained. No mapping, Skill, original workflow report, repair report or root analysis read.
